LanguageData.ABY_CircleRitual_Choir_Desc: Consumes one choir engine sigil, routes a colonist to the circle, and opens a disciplined support breach only after the first boss has already been cleared. The Choir Engine is not a raw damage monster; it amplifies escorts, floods defenders with targeting noise, suppresses turrets, and turns a stable firing line into a command-jammed kill zone.
LanguageData.ABY_CircleRitual_Choir_Rewards: • Post-first-boss progression checkpoint with real pressure instead of tutorial pacing • Guaranteed Choir Resonance Core recovery plus heavier residue payout • Unlocks a support-focused reward branch: four implants and the Canticle Driver sonic rifle
LanguageData.ABY_CircleRitual_Choir_SideEffects: • Escorts are actively buffed while the engine remains online • Nearby defenders and turrets suffer repeated signal interference and EMP suppression • Periodic choir pulses strengthen the whole breach host instead of relying on direct boss damage
LanguageData.ABY_ChoirSummonSuccessDesc: The command wafer has become a signal organ. A Choir Engine is entering local space with its escort pulled tight around the relay node, ready to jam turrets, amplify hostiles, and turn clean firing lanes into noise.
